sections.title: 1.2 Scope
sections.text_preview: This document contains the criteria by which the initial Mashbot release will be judged. It is written for the developers, testers, and end-users of Mashbot.

• External Service Account An account on a social networking platform outside of Mashbot

sections.title: 2.1.3 Hardware Interfaces
sections.text_preview:
The Mashbot web client runs on any computer hardware meeting the following criteria:

• Capable of connecting to the Internet

• Capable of running a modern HTTP 1.1 web browser

• Includes a keyboard

sections.text_preview:

sections.title: 2.1.6 Memory Constraints
sections.text_preview: The Mashbot server requires no greater than 1 gigabyte of RAM memory. The web client requires no more than the minimum memory a modern desktop computer commonly has, approximately 256 megabytes of RAM

sections.title: 4 User Interface
sections.text_preview:
The user interface will consist of a tabbed navigation bar that unifies the sitewide navigation, as well as module specific navigation as needed. Tabs:

• Dashboard

• Create

• Schedule

• Explore

sections.title: 4.1 Dashboard
sections.text_preview:
The dashboard consists of graphs and charts to give the user a quick view on how their campaigns are performing. Metrics include:

• Clickthrough rate

• Page Views

• Number of Comments
